title: Capitol Records drops 'offensive' AI rapper FN Meka (The Guardian)
notes: The Guardian (Sian Cain), 2022-08-24. FN Meka = AI rapper with appearance of a BLACK MALE cyborg (created 2019, Factory New: Martini + Le). Voiced by anonymous Black man. Capitol dropped him + apologized to Black community after racist-stereotype backlash (N-word in song; portrayed being beaten by police). Male-coded, NOT female.
